branch.new_demand: Leave the grid: draw rotation and reflection images with compass, protractor, and straightedge for slanted lines and non-right angles.
branch.builds_on: FORWARD 1 sequences grid transformations; FORWARD 2 carries out the same transformations without coordinates, using tools.

questions.skill: Draw rotations and reflections off the grid with compass, protractor, and straightedge
questions.standard_level: Geometry. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Geometry, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: Use a compass and protractor. Rotate point P 60° counterclockwise about point O. Mark and label the image P′.
questions.prompt_markup: Use a compass and protractor. Rotate point P 60° counterclockwise about point O. Mark and label the image P′.
questions.correct_answer: P′ is on the circle with center O through P, with m∠POP′ = 60° measured counterclockwise from ray OP.
questions.grading_note: Accept within about 2° and 2 mm. Evidence: the arc (or equal compass distance) from O and the 60° angle.
